products.title: Steam Puttu Podi

products.title: Instant Dosa Mix
products.description: Enjoy golden, crispy dosas without lengthy preparation. Made from a balanced blend of rice and black gram, it delivers authentic taste and consistent results.

products.title: Roasted Rava
products.description: Pre-roasted for added convenience, roasted rava saves preparation time while delivering excellent taste and texture. Ideal for upma, snacks, and desserts.

products.title: Chemba Puttu Podi
products.description: Prepared from quality red rice, chemba puttu podi brings the rich taste and wholesome goodness of Kerala's traditional breakfast to your kitchen.

products.title: Atta (Wheat Flour)
products.description: Finely milled from quality whole wheat, perfect for soft rotis, fluffy parathas, and a variety of traditional and modern recipes.

products.title: Roasted Ragi Powder
products.description: Made from carefully roasted finger millet, offering a rich source of natural nutrition along with distinctive flavour. Ideal for dosas, rotis, and porridges.

products.title: Wheat Puttu Podi
products.description: Made from roasted wheat flour, offering a delicious variation of the classic Kerala breakfast with rich texture and wholesome character. Ideal for traditional puttu podi preparations.

products.title: Instant Idli Mix

products.title: Steam Ragi Puttu Podi
products.description: Enjoy the wholesome goodness of ragi in a traditional breakfast favourite. Steam ragi puttu podi delivers the natural benefits of finger millet with satisfying texture and authentic taste.

categories.title: Kitchen Essentials
categories.description: Complete your kitchen with everyday essentials, including jaggery, sugar, salt, ginger paste, garlic paste, tamarind and vinegar. Carefully processed for freshness, quality and consistent flavour.

products.title: Garlic Paste
products.description: Garlic paste delivers the bold taste and aroma of fresh garlic in a smooth, ready-to-use form. It saves preparation time while enhancing the flavour of curries, marinades, gravies, and a variety of savoury recipes.

products.title: Ginger Garlic Paste
products.description: A balanced blend of ginger and garlic, this paste brings authentic flavour and aroma to a wide range of dishes. Its ready-to-use format saves time while helping create rich and flavourful meals.

products.title: Ginger Paste
products.description: Prepared for convenience and consistency, ginger paste offers the fresh aroma and flavour of ginger in an easy-to-use format. It is ideal for adding depth and character to everyday cooking.

products.title: Sugar
products.description: Made from carefully processed sugarcane, this sugar features fine crystals, clean sweetness, and excellent solubility. It is suitable for beverages, desserts, baking, and a wide range of everyday culinary applications.

products.title: Soya Chunks
products.description: Soya chunks provide a convenient source of plant-based protein with a firm texture that absorbs flavours well. They are suitable for curries, stir-fries, and a variety of wholesome everyday recipes.

products.title: Jaggery Powder
products.description: Jaggery powder offers the wholesome sweetness of traditional jaggery in a convenient and easy-to-use form. It blends effortlessly into beverages, desserts, and everyday recipes while adding a naturally rich flavour.

products.title: Jaggery
products.description: Jaggery balls are prepared from concentrated sugarcane juice and are known for their rich sweetness and traditional flavour. Widely used in authentic recipes and homemade preparations, they add depth and character to a variety of dishes.

products.title: Iodised Free Flow Salt
products.description: Powdered salt features fine iodised crystals that dissolve easily and distribute evenly throughout recipes. Its clean taste and dependable quality make it an essential ingredient for everyday cooking and seasoning.

products.title: Soya Balls
products.description: Soya balls offer the same nutritional benefits and versatility as other variants while providing a hearty texture. They absorb spices and seasonings effectively, making them suitable for rich and flavourful dishes.

products.title: Distilled White Vinegar
products.description: Vinegar provides balanced acidity and a clean flavour profile that complements a variety of culinary applications. It is ideal for pickling, preserving, marinating, and enhancing the taste of numerous recipes.

products.title: Asafoetida (Hing)
products.description: Known for its strong and distinctive aroma, Asafoetida adds depth and flavour to a variety of dishes. A small quantity is enough to enhance dals, curries, pickles, and traditional preparations.

products.title: Iodised Crystal Salt
products.description: Crystal salt contains clean, coarse crystals enriched with iodine to support everyday dietary needs. Its natural texture and balanced flavour make it suitable for a variety of cooking applications.

products.title: Tamarind
products.description: Tamarind delivers a distinctive tangy flavour that enhances a wide range of traditional recipes. Its natural sourness makes it an essential ingredient in curries, chutneys, gravies, and regional dishes.

categories.title: Pulses
categories.description: Our nutritious range of pulses includes green gram, red peas, black chana, white chana, horse gram, lentils and dals. Sourced with care to deliver wholesome nutrition and authentic taste.

products.title: Green Peas
products.description: Green peas add natural sweetness, vibrant colour, and tender texture to a variety of dishes. Whether used in curries, rice preparations, soups, or snacks, they enhance both flavour and nutritional value. Their versatility and freshness make them a staple ingredient in everyday cooking.

products.title: Masoor Dal
products.description: Masoor dal is known for its quick cooking time, smooth texture, and mild flavour. It is an excellent choice for preparing soups, curries, and wholesome home-cooked meals with ease. Rich in nutrients and easy to incorporate into everyday recipes, it offers both convenience and nourishment.

products.title: Green Gram (Cherupayar)
products.description: Green gram is widely appreciated for its versatility, gentle flavour, and nutritional goodness. Naturally rich in protein and fibre, it is easy to digest and suitable for a variety of preparations, from curries and soups to salads and breakfast dishes. Its light texture and wholesome character make it a staple for healthy everyday cooking.

products.title: Red Peas (Vanpayar)
products.description: Red peas are a cherished ingredient in traditional kitchens, valued for their firm texture, earthy flavour, and wholesome nutritional profile. They absorb flavours beautifully during cooking, making them ideal for curries, stews, and classic regional dishes. Rich in protein and fibre, they bring both nourishment and a satisfying bite to everyday meals.

products.title: White Chana
products.description: White chana is valued for its firm texture, rich taste, and ability to create hearty, satisfying meals. Whether prepared as flavourful curries, refreshing salads, or wholesome snacks, it offers an excellent balance of nutrition and flavour. Its versatility makes it a favourite ingredient in kitchens around the world.

products.title: Black Chana
products.description: Black chana is prized for its earthy flavour, firm texture, and impressive nutritional profile. Rich in fibre and protein, it is widely used in traditional dishes that are both nourishing and satisfying. Its robust character and wholesome goodness make it a valuable addition to everyday cooking.

products.title: Moong Dal
products.description: Moong dal is appreciated for its delicate flavour, light texture, and nutritional benefits. Naturally easy to digest, it is widely used in soups, curries, porridges, and healthy everyday meals. Its versatility and wholesome nature make it suitable for people of all ages.

products.title: Horse Gram
products.description: Horse gram is a traditional legume celebrated for its strong nutritional value and distinctive earthy flavour. Rich in protein and dietary fibre, it has been a trusted ingredient in regional cuisines for generations. Its hearty texture and wholesome character make it ideal for nourishing home-cooked meals.

products.title: Urad Gota (Urad Whole)
products.description: Urad whole is known for its dense texture, rich nutritional value, and versatility in traditional cooking. Commonly used in curries, dals, and fermented dishes, it contributes both flavour and substance to everyday meals. Its high protein content and distinctive taste make it an important ingredient in many regional recipes.

products.title: Ragi Whole
products.description: Ragi seeds have long been valued for their rich nutritional content and traditional significance. Naturally abundant in fibre, calcium, and essential nutrients, they form the foundation of many wholesome recipes. From porridges to baked dishes, they bring nourishment and goodness to everyday meals.

products.title: Urad Dal (Split)
products.description: Urad dal is known for its smooth texture, rich flavour, and versatility in traditional cooking. Widely used in dals, dosas, vadas, and a variety of regional dishes, it contributes both taste and nutritional value. Its creamy consistency makes it an essential ingredient in many beloved recipes.

products.title: Toor Dal
products.description: A cornerstone of Indian cuisine, toor dal is loved for its comforting taste, smooth texture, and versatility. It cooks into rich, flavourful dals that pair perfectly with rice and traditional accompaniments. Packed with protein and essential nutrients, it brings warmth, nourishment, and familiar flavours to every meal.

products.title: Tender Mango Pickle
products.description: Made from tender mangoes, this pickle offers a perfect balance of tangy and spicy flavours with authentic spices.

products.title: Hot & Sweet Pickle
products.description: A harmonious combination of heat and sweetness, this pickle brings excitement to every bite with traditional Kerala spices.

products.title: Garlic Pickle
products.description: Rich and pungent garlic flavours infused with traditional spices, perfect for adding depth to your culinary creations.

products.title: Sliced Mango Pickle
products.description: Thin slices of mango preserved in a savoury and spicy brine, offering a refreshing condiment for everyday meals.

products.title: Mango Ginger Pickle
products.description: A warming blend of mango and ginger with traditional spices, this pickle stimulates the palate with its complex flavours.

products.title: Puli Inchi Pickle
products.description: A traditional Kerala speciality, this sour and spicy pickle brings authentic flavours and nostalgia to your table.

products.title: Mixed Vegetable Pickle
products.description: A colourful medley of vegetables in a tangy spice blend, offering variety and nutrition in every spoonful.

products.title: Lemon Pickle
products.description: Tangy and refreshing, this classic pickle made from fresh lemons brings zesty flavours to complement any meal.

products.title: Fish Pickle
products.description: A savoury and protein-rich pickle with authentic Kerala flavours, perfect for those seeking unique taste experiences.

products.title: Idi Irachi Pickle
products.description: A traditional delicacy with tender meat pieces, this pickle combines authentic spices for a memorable dining experience.

products.title: Spring Murukku
products.description: Spring Murukku is loved for its airy crunch and savoury flavour. Its light texture and satisfying crispness make it a snack that's enjoyable at any time of the day.

products.title: Peanut Roast
products.description: Carefully roasted to bring out their natural flavour, these peanuts offer a rich taste and satisfying crunch. Perfect as a wholesome snack, they are enjoyable anytime, anywhere.

products.title: Sweet Kuzhalappam
products.description: Sweet Kuzhalappam combines a delicate crunch with just the right touch of sweetness. Loved for its traditional flavour and satisfying texture, it is a snack that brings joy to every bite.

products.title: Pakkavada
products.description: Known for its bold crunch and satisfying spice, Pakkavada is a tea-time classic enjoyed by snack lovers everywhere. Its crispy texture and flavourful taste make it a delicious companion for every break.

products.title: Kuzhalappam
products.description: Known for its distinctive shape and satisfying crunch, Kuzhalappam is a traditional snack enjoyed across generations. Its authentic flavour and crisp texture make it a timeless favourite.

products.title: Sharkara Varatti
products.description: A festive favourite with deep roots in Kerala tradition, Sharkara Varatti combines crisp banana pieces with a rich coating of sweetness. Every bite offers a delightful blend of crunch, flavour, and nostalgia.

products.title: Palak Murukku

products.title: Chilli Mixture

products.title: Heart Biscuits

products.title: Achappam Sweet
products.description: Achappam brings together a delicate crunch and authentic traditional flavour in every bite. Light, crispy, and wonderfully satisfying, it is a snack that adds a touch of nostalgia to every occasion.
